pages.text: These artifacts are in the Anubis Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Anubis to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.

A sword that gains souls from kills and unlocks tiers at 50, 150, and 500 souls. Hold Shift over it to inspect progress. At 500 souls a full-strength strike can deal double damage to foes that are neither undead nor made of stone. Death halves the stored souls.
